name: Grappling hook & swing
oneLiner: Fire a hook at iron rings (aim assist) or any rock surface, hang on a rope of fixed length and swing like a pendulum, pump with left / right, reel in and out, jump off or let go keeping the swing's momentum; the rope wraps around corners and unwraps on the way back. The game keeps its own collision: the module only proposes the swing's velocity (capped under half a tile per step) and the game moves the hero with its own wall tests. Pixel braided rope or smooth rope, a claw hook, glowing rings, aim reticle, sparks. Deterministic, inert until the grapple button is pressed.
notFor: top-down games (no gravity to swing in)
games whose hero has no velocity / per-step movement code (it needs a body with vx, vy)

needs: a fixed update step where the hero's velocity code runs (also run by ?t= fast-forward and ?auto=1)
the hero's box and velocity {x, y, w, h, vx, vy, onGround, facing} in world px and the game's own units
the game's wall test solid(x, y) in world px, its tile size and gravity
a grapple button (pressed / held), left / right, reel in / out, jump pressed
the draw pass inside the camera transform, next to the hero
reset on new run, respawn, life lost
provides: update() -> {active, flying, vx, vy}: the swing's velocity while on the rope, the carried momentum after letting go
ring anchors and surface hooks with aim assist and a reticle
rope wrap / unwrap around corners, snag release
events fire, attach, release, miss, snag, wrap, unwrap, reel (onEvent)
state(), stats(), ropePath(), hash() for tests and judges

assets: module/grapple-swing.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_Grapple): hook flight and target pick, rope constraint and pendulum, reel, wrap / unwrap around convex tile corners, momentum carry, rope / hook / ring / reticle / spark drawing in pixel and smooth modes
demo/world.js: the demo's little platformer and bot tour (pure logic, also used by node checks); the climber hero is drawn in code in demo/index.html
no image, font or audio files
